title: Perseus of Macedon
summary: Raleigh names Perseus of Macedon in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Perseus, the last king of Macedon, ouerthrowne by Paulus Aemylius. He is not Perseus the father of Erythraeus, and not Perseus the sonne of Danae. The one-word title would fold onto those records, so the title is three words. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
